title: The Reunion Affair
author: Patricia Johnson
description: Mary and Bill were high school sweethearts but the war separated them. They married another but at the reunion they found the sparks were still there.

messages.text: Is this a bad time to text Mary?
No it is not Bill. Jack is gone to work.
It was sure nice to see you at the reunion.
It was. You have not changed a bit.
Then you must need glasses.
To me you are still the handsome man I loved.
And you are still the sexy cheerleader.
Now who needs glasses?
Will you meet me tonight?
I am married Bill.
So am I but the spark is still there.
Yes it is but we are both married.
I know that. You have reminded me enough.
We should not have kissed.
Yes we should have. It was right.
I have never cheated on Jack.
And I have never cheated on Sue.
Then why are we talking about it?
Because we still desire each other.
This may be true but does not make it right.
The war separated us.
We should have married before you shipped out.
We didn’t but you should have waited. You promised.
They said you had died. I grieved for a year.
You should have waited longer.
I know but I was lonely.
I regret conforming to the rules of that time.
Me too. But I was afraid of getting pregnant
I would have married you.
I know but did not want a “have too marriage.”
That is the past. This is now. Meet me.
I have never been with another man.
I wish I could say the same but cannot.
I don’t know Bill.
Don’t turn me down again like you did prom night.
Okay I will meet you.
You will? That makes me happy.
At noon, Airport Motel.
Don’t chicken out again.
I won’t.
I love you. I have protection.
I love you. What room?
Room 13.
Leaving now.
See you soon my darling.
Bill, car will not start. I’m going to be late.
Sorry, but I have to make my flight.
Please wait.
I can’t wait. I have to go.
No!
We were never meant to consummate our love.
I love you Bill forever.
I will always love you Mary.
It is so unfair.
Yes it is but life is not fair.
Wait, I want to go with you.
You can’t Mary. It is not your time.
Not my time. What do you mean?
Look on your pillow.
Your dog tags? But this means…
Yes, I am dead.
But your body…
On the Beaches of Normandy…mass grave.
But this feels so real…the reunion.
My spirit…saying I love you and good bye my love.
